## Problem and result

Describe what triggers the problem, the resulting behavior and why the change is needed.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their outcomes. State material limits, including untested platforms.

## Review

- [ ] Focused change with a conventional PR title; no secrets, site data or build outputs.
- [ ] Formatting, applicable tests and required CI pass.
- [ ] Documentation/changelog updated when behavior or release expectations change.
- [ ] Private stack source and existing licensing boundary preserved.
